visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman in a beige trench coat riding a bicycle down a tree-lined Parisian street. The camera is a handheld moving shot from the side. The lighting is bright natural daylight with the sun filtering through green leaves. (2) A quick cut shows a scenic view of traditional European architecture with grey mansard roofs under a clear blue sky, seen from a bridge over a cobblestone road. (3) Returning to the girl, she continues cycling and smiling. (4) The scene shifts to the exterior of Notre-Dame de Paris. Two women, one with long dark hair and sunglasses and the other holding the camera, smile together in a close-up selfie shot. (5) Inside the cathedral, the camera pans upwards to show high vaulted ceilings, massive stone pillars, and intricate stained-glass rose windows. Large ornate gold chandeliers and a golden cross are prominent against the warm, dim indoor lighting. (6) The creator and her sister appear in a close-up inside the church, both grinning widely at the camera. (7) Outside, the woman walks toward a 'Léon' restaurant. Inside, she is shown eating a large black pot of mussels, clinking glasses with her companion, and displaying a paper bill. (8) At the Stravinsky Fountain, she sits on the edge of the basin near colorful moving sculptures. The background shows Parisian buildings and street life. (9) A sunny park scene features people lying on the grass. A medium shot highlights a shirtless man sunbathing. (10) A brief flashback or old video clip shows children playing on a slide. (11) Back on a modern city street, the woman walks and talks to her sister, making playful 'fighting' gestures and posing cutely for the camera in a medium close-up.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat French acoustic guitar music starts immediately, accompanied by the whirring of bicycle tires on pavement. A female voice speaks in an excited Mandarin tone about making a reservation. The vocal pitch is high and the tempo is fast. (2) As the scene transitions to Notre-Dame, the acoustics shift to include more reverb, reflecting the large stone structure. The two sisters laugh and talk about the cathedral's cleaning, with their voices clear and prominent over the ongoing BGM. (3) Entering the restaurant, the background noise floor changes to include muffled restaurant chatter and the metallic clinking of pots and silverware. A rustling sound of paper occurs as the bill is shown. The speakers' tone remains humorous and casual. (4) The final segment features a mix of outdoor street ambience—distant traffic and bird chirps—as the women walk. Playful laughter and quick, energetic vocal exchanges dominate the mix until the music fades out at the end.
